description: This file contains a class named CommonStorageTests which defines a suite of unit tests and helper methods for testing grain storage implementations in an Orleans-based application. It includes methods for creating test grain references, reading/writing state, and testing concurrency and error conditions.

classes.name: CommonStorageTests
classes.description: A class containing common storage test methods for Orleans grain storage providers, ensuring consistent behavior across different back-ends.

methods.name: GetTestReferenceAndState
methods.description: Creates a grain ID and associated grain state for testing, given a long grainId or a string grainId, with an initial ETag version.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_Relational_WriteReadIdCyrillic
methods.description: Tests writing and reading a grain state with potentially Cyrillic characters in the grain ID, verifying data consistency.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to write a duplicate state with a null ETag results in an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteInconsistentFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Checks that writing an inconsistent state with a non-matching version throws an InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: PersistenceStorage_WriteReadWriteReadStatesInParallel
methods.description: Performs parallel write/read operations across multiple grains to test concurrency and version management.

methods.name: Store_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and reading grain state, verifying version updates and state correctness.

methods.name: Store_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests the basic write and read operations for grain state, checking consistency and existence.
